name: La Roda de Andalucía (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white at the upper fly and blue at the lower hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Roda de Andalucía (castles and a chequy bend on yellow and red).
history: Municipal flag of La Roda de Andalucía; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
